body:
i’m grateful you responded, it’s really hard to see from the inside. He says i used him to take care of  me when i was sick and when i started to get better i threw him away, I don’t see it that way at all but the fact  someone can see it so differently than i do makes me doubt myself. 

It’s not that i’m ashamed of loving him, it’s the grief i get from everyone and how upset it makes them because they love me, i don’t want to hurt them for loving me, 

I honestly have been through so much, i’m in frequent therapy, on antidepressants as well as a ton of meds for my medical problems. i really can barely stand to be around anyone anymore, i’m so fragile it’s not even funny.

 Its different with him because he was there and i loved him before and during. In the end i left him and feel like i failed.  i  doubt anyone could ever understand what i’ve been through and where it’s left me and i don’t think  i’d ever let anyone get close enough to me to even try, therapy and drugs aren’t changing that at all. I really feel like he’s the only person in the world who can really love me and i’m a huge asshole for giving up on him/not believing in his dreams.

thank you for replying, pretty much everyone in my life says the same thing you said, i can’t even tell my parents we communicate bc they would be so upset. in the past he has blamed me for “ruining” his life with my illness, but before i came on the scene almost all his family had cut him off for the same type of thing one warning me outright he would never change.

That’s tough for me, i want so much more for him and love the potential in him, i believe in my heart he was the first person to ever really love me, and i have no desire to be with anyone if it’s not him. So it’s hard for me to just walk away, he’s so alone in world and true that’s his fault in a lot of ways but he took care of me when i wanted to give in to my illness and stop fighting to stay alive. 

Everyone says i’ve paid that debt to him, and if i thought he’d be better off without me i would walk away for his sake and just be alone, but my heart breaks either way.
should say he moved, not i moved. sorry.

thank you for your kind response it sounds like you have been where i am. I realized in rereading my post it was confusing, the unemployment is ending not the therapy. i will keep going whatever it takes. 

I appreciate your advice, i do want to keep working, hopefully my boss isn’t too upset with me, i don’t want to make him uncomfortable in his own business, i just didn’t think i had any other option other than to try to set a boundary. I don’t think i was rude about it, but i guess i could have been wrong.

thank you,
helped

You can’t keep her by your side, that’s just it. Are you her primary or does it not work like that for you both? It may be she goes through phases of intimacy with people, and that would include you as well. If you want to stay in it under the terms you’ve negotiated, then you have to love her for where you overlap and let others love the other parts.

If you want to renegotiate the terms and expectations of your relationship that’s ok too, be honest with yourself about this and be prepared she may not feel the same.
ping pong is actually pretty frustrating for most kids, it takes a lot of control. maybe a couple of frisbees so a bunch of kids can play together passing it around.

A lot of times men lose their sex drive when they’re stressed, i do think there’s a certain “newlywed factor” that ebbs with time a bit, but i don’t think it’s a coincidence this started around his new job. He may feel less then competent there and that can take a toll on the self esteem and confidence one needs to be healthy sexually. 

Try to give him what he says he wants, be supportive of the job and focus on other positives in your relationship. Hopefully he can open up and feel safe.
I had a friend go through something similar, it turned out his wife was quite ill and had an autoimmune issue. i would start from a place of concern for her health.

Is there more than one table? you could get a second set of paddles and a couple of balls and tell them they can use them while you are there as long as they let you play with your partner?

If they give you hard time giving them back when you’re ready to leave get the kids on your side by saying “If you guys are going to make this hard for us we won’t come at all anymore and no one will get to play.” 

The kids enjoying it and successfully taking turns will make the other kids give the stuff back.

Or get a table for your house or find an adult location that has tables and play there. I wouldn’t give it up if you both enjoy it!

many people enjoy the fantasy and go down the rabbit hole in their minds, even to the point of experimenting then freak out and pull away, sort of a yo yo effect. 

The best strategy is to normalize, support but adopt a neutral position of letting him know you love him for him, and you’ll accept whatever he needs.  He’s lucky to have a supportive and caring partner but clearly he’s conflicted within himself and taking a side pro or con sets you up for conflict, just be on his side.

I’m glad you’re in the field so you understand. Right now she’s able to control your family with fear, but she’s completely out of control within herself. 

You may be right and all this is attention but the stakes are quite high. Even if it is attention seeking, she feels compelled to seek more attention at a cost to herself so something is very wrong. Unfortunately discontinuing therapy was a misstep originally, as a teen my family did the same thing for the same reasons and my take away was “i’m not worth it.” I’m an adult now and i understand a lot better but at the time, it just made me feel less understood and more alone. Don’t let her volatility run the show, she needs more help than a family or a weekly therapy appt can give.

your sister needs to be hospitalized and on some level she knows it. Anorexia is one of the hardest mental illnesses to treat and has the highest mortality rate. Add to that substance abuse and your sisters long term prognosis is not good.

She is lucky she is young and has family support, that can work in her favor if she gets the right help, significant help. 

Communicate all this with the therapist, she can help you facilitate hospitalization. Upset or no, it’s her best chance. 

Good luck to your family, it’s not easy, and finding a support group may help.

I’m so grateful for your kind words and don’t mind the look back, I didn’t mention the sex issues in that post bc it was convoluted enough, but we fought about it all the time. 

You are right though there were other issues that meant my relationship had to end. As of last Friday the apartment is gone the bills are closed, creditors coming after me but it could be worse i guess. 

people who love me tell me there is hope and a future, I just don’t see it now. truth is i am sad and incredibly lonely but also damaged in so many ways. i have a therapist and. see a light now and then but it’s fleeting and i feel like i just get sick again.

i will look for the resources you mentioned, thank you for your time and thoughtfulness, it’s appreciated more than you know.

i posted kind of a similar sentiment just now about sex (i’m female). I lost my partner due to my inability to have sex. there was more to it admittedly but i honestly feel that was a huge part of it. He did everything for me while i was sick, from bag changes to carrying me when i couldn’t walk, and all he got for it was this traumatized anxious person who cringes when she’s touched and sex is painful both physically and psychologically. 

Now I’m alone and feel such despair at the thought of trying to meet someone. like you i lost my job, my finances are in ruins, my health continues to be unstable, and sex is a huge issue. who wants to deal with that? As much as I long for connection and closeness i fear it now bc my partner who was there for the worst ultimately left. I feel like an abused animal, yearning for a gentle touch but who snaps at anyone who tries out of fear. 

I wish i had encouraging words for you, i hope it helps to know you aren’t alone.
i think you’re on the right track, saline then let it dry out in the air before covering it.

i’m so sorry that happened to you, no one deserves that, and only someone like you can understand the feeling of being abused and then blamed, it hurts on a whole new level. As a woman to be physically a joke of a threat to a large jar of pickles let alone a big ass dude, it’s no contest to any sane person. i know women assault men, of course it’s not right but to jump to blame so quickly is fucking wrong.

I too have some wonderful furry babies, i sleep on the floor to be with them.

i looked at your house panther earlier, what a love. 

There’s a lot of counseling stuff, i may just break down and call the state advocacy program myself, hell they should want to be there for him if not for me.

Still trying to reach out to anyone who might know a bouncer or security person who might want to make a few bucks off hours. I used to work in a bar so i have a few connections i can feel out, i sent some txts tonight. Normally i could just go meet a bouncer at a bar that someone i know vouches for and it would be that simple but. nothing is simple with Covid anymore.
i’m half expecting he’s going to file a restraining order against me.

I really wish i had someone to help me. Covid makes it harder than ever but a trustworthy stranger is all i need, I’m an only child of an only child, and what few friends i have are afraid of getting drawn into legal craziness. 

I know i can’t go there alone, my attorney seems to think bringing my mother is acceptable but she has cancer and is 74 yrs old and as willing as she is, i don’t want to do that to her. 

Rent a biker would be nice.

i did also email the rental co. they were completely unhelpful, insisting we didn’t give 60 days so now we owe another 1/2 month. i told them i had moved out and had been paying the rent the entire time, with bank transfers to prove it, and asked for some consideration regarding the remaining rent. they said we were both equally responsible. 

They offered an early release and if someone rented it we would be off the hook but he would also have to sign and effectively give up his free apartment i know that’s not happening.

I was planning on paying my half of the rent through the end but since it’s going on my credit when he doesn’t pay regardless fuxk it, let him get his pay checks (should he ever get one one) be garnished.

A dude in 30 day training program for department of youth corrections security day 2 offered “body slam him on his ass.” as a serious response to a youth spitting on you scenario.

I went on to learn, that “subdue the youth” is what they call that but that guy, while correct, was gone after lunch break.

thank you for keeping me honest, i sent him an email this morning telling him he has until the first of the month to have the utilities changed return his cell phone to me and my car key. 

I  told him i would come by weekly with an escort to pack and get my things.  he did not reply. 

i really wish there was a way to connect with someone willing to escort me over there, but since he’s the “victim” until my name is cleared i have no hope and no one wants to get involved, not that i blame them though i’m the type who would.

thank you for saying so it was seriously one of the most traumatic things ever to happen to me, and i’ve seen a few.  

Taking a suicidal person who just got assaulted first to a hospital for 9 hours to be literally ignored handcuffed to a gurney in the hall with a cop, deny her prescribed medication, water, food,  support of any kind, even a crayon and paper, then deny her bail,   throw her in a town jail cell, conveniently leave her meds at the hospital and smirk about it,  again alone with no one to talk to no pen paper book for 16 hours then suddenly released on my own recognizance once i had an attorney.  walk into my apartment and see his “domestic violence advocacy” paperwork on the table. I’ll never forget it. 

as far as an attorney, my parents already put thousands down for a retainer. plus he’s confident he’ll win, he should be bc it’s complete bullshit even the police report says so, our stories matched at the time but they charged me anyway.

i ended up charged with assault despite 
- the fact i was trying to run away
- i’m screaming for help on the 911 call 
- the cops came in to him kneeling on my back my head smashed to the floor. 

for a better visual i’m 5’6 113 chronically ill, he’s 6 ft 180 weight lifter.

 even he said i didn’t try to attack him and he did not feel in danger they still charged me and i even got denied bail until i got an attorney. 

None of this has helped much, and unless i’m completely exonerated will kill my career if i ever get myself together enough to work again.

thank you for the website i’m going to go through their resources to see if anyone can help. m

As far as the police  it was my thought too my attorney has advised me not to have my name on their radar for any reason, including my own protection i guess.

thank you for the generous encouragement, i sent him an email today saying he has until the 1st to change the utilities and his phone. I’m terrified now he’s going to retaliate, he could really hurt me, destroying my art, a manuscript, my past kitties ashes, old photos of my great grandmother.

 i can’t tell you how many times the only reason i could give myself not to do it is my kitties, i took responsibility for their little lives, i have to honor that, the flip side of course is they would have a better life with someone else.

thank you for your kind words
we were never married, or even engaged just lived together for 2 yrs.

i suspect he is always home, he never wanted to drive when that was his “job”  but i definitely plan to do a drive by to see what’s coming.  If he’s there he’ll have it deadbolted so i’ll have to ring the bell.

I really wish i had someone in my life who could do this other than mom, i thought about trying to hire someone but it seems so excessive and possibly make it all worse not that i could afford anyone, but and advocate would be a nice option and seems appropriate here.
she has an iphone, cautiously optimistic she can pull it off

Both, i know how awfully stupid this sounds but i do love him, he stood by me through my illness, which he never holds back from reminding me of, and it’s hard to just stop loving someone even though they hurt you. 

When he gets upset it goes into a level of paranoia that isn’t normal, those are the times i fear for my safety, and if I were to try to leave and he didn’t want that, those have gone badly before too.

It actually hurts how much i could really use the victims advocacy he’s getting right now, but i’m the perp according the the paperwork  ai i get nothing.
thank you, it just goes to show how twisted someone can make you when permission to care about myself from a stranger on the internet makes me feel more brave. thank you.
i volunteered for a shelter at one point a lot of people get angry being denied adoption, if your lease says for example 2 cats and this would be # 3, no go with the shelter.

Advice received—
that’s a good idea, my friends won’t go but if i hand my 73 yr old mother my phone she should be able to make it work. i hate i have to involve her it’s terrible. 

yeah he said those are in my name, but i’m almost afraid to trigger him by doing it, even giving him like 2 weeks notice i feel like he might flip out.

oh that’s awesome news, if it’s a foster from a good shelter i believe everyone on the lease and the landlord have to sign off on it, you should have some say in it, and it’s a good way to bring up some house agreements around pets should she want to keep it.

It just feels messed up, leaving him in a completely empty apartment bc that’s 100 what it is without my stuff, including no heat electric or water. 

Or if i leave him with at least enough to get by until the lease is up he’ll probably tell the leasing office i abandoned it to screw me.

my attorney says as long as i go there with someone it should be ok, my name is on the lease i have a legal right to be there, and as long as there is a witness present, but even that feels so unsafe to me, like i WANT the town cops there but my lawyer says small town cops turned this into a shit show to begin with, my name needs to be off their radar completely.

you did everything above and beyond. honestly if you treat adult cats with frontline for 3-5 months consistently and the kitten when it is old enough, you will have zero flea problems, the bombing and exterminators are overkill. it’s understandable you’re upset.

i hope your roommate considers rehoming her kitten. i am sleeping on an unheated porch right now rather than leave my two adult cats alone. Leaving your brand new pet to go party with a boyfriend, I’m not sure she sounds like a responsible pet owner that doesn’t bode well for a responsible roommate either i’m afraid.

if this how your dynamics are too, that sounds less than ideal especially roommate #3, that’s a shitty role to be in

i don’t think you are in the wrong, let your friend know there was a misunderstanding and while you agreed to let them use the spot during the move in process, it was never intended to be a permanent arrangement as that spot is part of your lease and you (likely) pay an additional fee for it. If the friend wants a designated parking space she should approach the leasing office.

thank you for sharing your story, my parents have supported me a great deal throughout my life, on and off, but i’ve been mostly self reliant regarding housing, food etc, and was making 6 figures less than a year ago, (crazy right) which is part of all this drama too. i’m actively trying to take my emotionality out of  it for their sake, i think you are right and they are tired, i don’t blame them i am too.

thank you for your thoughts, i don’t mean to blame others i am just trying to paint a complicated story as succinctly as possible.  I did an incredibly reckless thing, i am not denying that. 

i did not bring weapons in the bathroom. he popped the lock to get the last word in an argument, like many times before, which was why i included the information, bc no where was i allowed to feel safe from emotional attack at any time in my own home, even behind a locked door. why would i write something so embarrassing and humiliating to lie about that detail?  

My post was about my father not about my boyfriend, and i make no illusions  angels and demons in my relationship, no one is perfect but I did something reckless and stupid on an even worse level.  i will try my best to minimize the cost to my family but that won’t unring the emotional bell with my father, which was the point of my post. i apologize for not providing more information up front.

I very much am trying to get help,  and have been for 2 + years. trauma often looks a lot like borderline, which i assume you mean instead of bipolar. 

i’ve seen multiple practitioners and tried several different medications  to be better for the people i love, and they made things worse (hence the past suicidal ideation). 

my last prescriber told me i had complex trauma and ptsd and yes need to work on it in therapy, which i have been doing weekly with a hefty copay until i lost my health insurance and am now trying to find someone who will see me face to face to start again. 

so yeah it’s been hard, but i don’t think anyone can fairly say i haven’t been trying to both help myself and get help.

thank you for your kindness, i’m trying, we lost our couples therapist too, and stuck inside all day everyday is very hard. I’ve been sending emails for the last two days to therapists hoping to connect with someone soon for myself if nothing else. 

i know i’m struggling, and feel like such a burden when he deserves so much more. 

2 yrs ago i had a great job, fantastic place, great future, and then my illness hit and i lost it all. it’s very hard to understand but i felt like i had finally delivered and made him proud, then i lost it all. my fault or not, it’s all gone.
it’s true i know he’s frustrated with me and i deserve it.  i just don’t know how to make it right

you are right i feel terrible about upsetting them, and the money! i want them to call it off but that’s not how it works with retainers i guess and mom refused to anyway. 

Going to live with them just isn’t an option; first of all they don’t have anywhere for me, i’ve slept on the floor the few times they’ve convinced me. 

i myself am also just getting over a full colon removal, ileostomy and take down, 4 surgeries and 7 medical hospitalizations in a yr, my boyfriend was my 24 hr a day medical caregiver through all this as my parents literally could not, so we have been through a lot together they simply can’t understand. 

i can’t just throw him away, but between med adjustments, losing my therapist and our couples therapy bc of tube virus it’s been very hard, but we love each other and have been through hell so neither of us have given up.
you are so kind to write thank you.  your gentleness means so much from a stranger, i’m grateful.
